summary: Comprehensive frontend-only E2E testing of the OAB-SP Anuidade 2026 checkout prototype on https://oab-checkout.preview.emergentagent.com. All 18 critical interactive flows tested via Playwright passed. No backend testing required (pure client-side mocked app).

tests_executed.hero_load: PASS - Hero H1 'Um checkout à altura da advocacia paulista.' renders with both CTAs (hero-cta-primary / hero-cta-secondary).
tests_executed.hero_cta_scroll: PASS - Clicking hero-cta-primary scrolls #checkout into view.
tests_executed.flow_and_stepper: PASS - flow-toggle, flow-toggle-multi/single, and step-dot-identification/payment/confirmation all visible.
tests_executed.identification_continue: PASS - Lawyer card shows 'Dr. Ricardo Almeida Souza' pre-filled, continue-to-payment advances to Payment step.
tests_executed.pix_copy: PASS - copy-pix-button copies PIX payload and shows 'Copiado' feedback + toast.
tests_executed.credit_installment_slider: PASS - Selecting payment-method-credit shows installment-slider; moving to 12× updates order-summary live ('12× no cartão · R$ 90,45').
tests_executed.boleto_panel: PASS - copy-boleto-line and download-boleto buttons visible and clickable.
tests_executed.bank_debit: PASS - bank-itau, bank-bb, bank-bradesco, bank-santander, bank-caixa, bank-nubank all visible; active state updates on click.
tests_executed.wallet: PASS - wallet-apple, wallet-google, wallet-confirm visible and switchable.
tests_executed.toggle_discount: PASS - toggle-discount flips total (R$ 909,04 <-> R$ 1.010,05) live in order-summary.
tests_executed.confirm_payment_success: PASS - confirm-payment-button shows Processando… (~1.4s), transitions to success screen with confirmation code OAB-XXXXXX-2026 (e.g. OAB-130852-2026).
tests_executed.pdf_download: PASS - download-receipt-button initiates real jsPDF download 'comprovante-anuidade-2026.pdf'.
tests_executed.restart_flow: PASS - restart-flow returns to step 0 (Identificação) with continue-to-payment visible again.
tests_executed.single_page_flow: PASS - flow-toggle-single stacks Identificação + Payment in one card with sticky order summary.
tests_executed.problem_section: PASS - #problem section renders and is scrollable.
tests_executed.mobile_view: PASS - At 390x844 the header, hero, and CTAs remain visible and readable.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: BankDebitPanel selected state is local (useState in component) and is not persisted in CheckoutContext nor reflected in success screen — acceptable for a prototype but worth noting if real flow is ever wired up.
Minor: WalletPanel selection (apple/google) is also local-only and is not surfaced in success methodLabel (always shown as 'Apple Pay / Google Pay'). Cosmetic for a prototype.
Minor: CardForm number/name/expiry/cvc are stored in local useState and discarded on unmount — fine for a mock but means switching from Credit -> Debit -> Credit resets typed data.
Strength: Good use of data-testid throughout, clean accessibility (aria-label on theme toggle, role=slider on Radix), and the jsPDF receipt generation works end-to-end.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: None — all data is mocked in /app/frontend/src/lib/checkout-data.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only marketing/prototype site. Public URL: https://oab-checkout.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend calls. PIX copy uses navigator.clipboard (grant clipboard-read/write permissions in Playwright context). PDF download is a real jsPDF blob (use page.expect_download). Confirm-payment has a hardcoded 1.4s delay before transitioning to success step — wait ~2s. All payment-method-* / bank-* / wallet-* / field-* data-testids work as documented in the request.
